# Book of Giants Fragment 8 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all lines in Book of Giants Fragment 8 (Judgment Approaches) where the three translators diverged, along with SOPHIA's resolution.

---

## 8:1 — "sent word / sent a message"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "God sent-word by-the-hand-of Raphael" — literal Aramaic idiom |
| LOGOS | "God sent word by the hand of Raphael" — formal |
| PNEUMA | "God sent a message through the angel Raphael" — modernized |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "sent word by the hand of Raphael." The idiom "by the hand of" is the standard Semitic expression for agency.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 8:9 — "uncleanness / defilement"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "in-all their-uncleanness" — literal tum'a |
| LOGOS | "in all their uncleanness" — formal |
| PNEUMA | "wallowing in every kind of defilement" — adds "wallowing" and expands |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "in all their uncleanness." PNEUMA's "wallowing" is an interpretive addition.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 8:15 — "arts of adornment / cosmetics and beautification"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the-arts-of adornment" — preserves Aramaic compound |
| LOGOS | "the arts of adornment" — formal |
| PNEUMA | "cosmetics and beautification" — splits into two modern terms |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "arts of adornment." This preserves the single Aramaic concept without modern fragmentation.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 8:16 — "eternal secrets / eternal mysteries"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the-eternal secrets which-were in-heaven" — literal razin |
| LOGOS | "the eternal secrets which were in heaven" — formal |
| PNEUMA | "the eternal mysteries that belonged in heaven" — adds "belonged" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "the eternal secrets which were in heaven." The Aramaic razin is best rendered "secrets" in this context; "mysteries" (PNEUMA) is acceptable but less precise.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

*Total disagreements for Fragment 8: 4*
